commit.message:
Merge updated PR15 and upstream master into symmetry fix

Integrate the upstream PeizeLin implementation and the validated accumulator and atom-list corrections while retaining all symmetry filtering changes.

Merge upstream master and retain tested regression fixes

Upstream now contains the original PeizeLin commits already imported here. Keep the independent const-input accumulator and corrected Hartree atom-list indexing. The merged tree is identical to the previously validated PR head.

Keep const tensor inputs independent of accumulators

Copy the input when initializing an empty result with unit coefficient. Tensor assignment shares storage, so subsequent in-place additions otherwise change the input and other accumulators. Cover independent outputs and complex accumulation coefficients.

Fix atom-list indexing in indexed Hartree loops

Use the right atom list to bound the density loop and the left atom list to select mu in the CVC loop. Add scalar-reference regressions for distinct and unequal atom partitions.

1. change fac_add_Ds to Tdata

(cherry picked from commit 6534722c2c4925d521793b3d279052ef3c7be886)

1. fix fac_add_Ds bug in LRI-cal_loop3_GPU

(cherry picked from commit fe27bb14d9abbccd9d05296a0833278acc7f34f4)
test: use real scaling coefficients in symmetry regression

fix(gpu): filter output pairs without truncating intermediate sums

In the four a01b2_a2b01 contractions, Aa2 is an intermediate atom
summed into the (Aa01, Ab01) output. Applying filter_for2 to
(Aa01, Aa2) drops valid terms. Apply it once Ab01 is available.

Add standalone CPU/DDLA regression coverage against unfiltered CPU
contractions masked independently by output atom pairs and cells.
Cover all 18 labels and their sum, real/complex tensors, empty and
seeded outputs, and signed/zero/fractional increments.

Validated CPU-only and DDLA v0.0.4/CUDA builds on V100 with 1 and 4
OpenMP threads. The two preceding symmetry fixes are cherry-picked
from maki49; this regression additionally catches the four remaining
incorrect contraction paths.

(cherry picked from commit 2781215e73813de9d58fc45a6087b7b857659f45)

Fix GPU symmetry filtering for all LibRI contraction labels

(cherry picked from commit a0db48f56ffadf448c8057788df57562b42cd3c8)
(cherry picked from commit dc1084707f51615ca34e479bb15299e4b1da4540)

Fix GPU EXX real-space symmetry filtering

(cherry picked from commit 2f77684417313e78e2da67aeee2ebf9b44f1e9fe)
(cherry picked from commit 87f521fa2a8c159bbe955dd729f2ec4c862ae688)

Fix scaled accumulation in GPU contractions

Apply fac_add_Ds while merging downloaded GPU contributions through the
existing tensor accumulation helper. Remove the unused GPU result map
and locks; the result merge runs outside the OpenMP packing regions.

Add regression coverage for signed, zero and fractional coefficients,
seeded outputs, repeated calls and combined contraction labels.

Fix DDLA GPU compilation (#14)

* Fix DDLA device error checks

Use the external ddla::DEVICE_CHECK function exposed by DDLA v0.0.4. The LibRI macro rename in 123517d incorrectly changed these calls as well.

* Update GPU contraction cleanup calls

Follow the cleanup API split from 6ce3c84, releasing locks and removing empty result entries through the same helpers as the CPU paths.
